missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Роман' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Этот' points at a specific one, and 'длинный' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Роман' is the accusative direct object of 'читаю', identical to the nominative because the noun is inanimate masculine. 'Новый' agrees in the accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Романа' is in the genitive case after 'нет', expressing absence. 'Этого' agrees in the genitive masculine, pointing to a specific book.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Роману' is in the dative case after 'посвящён', which governs the dative of the thing dedicated to. 'Толстого' is genitive marking authorship.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with увлекаться. 'Романом' is in the instrumental case because 'увлекаться' governs the instrumental. 'Этим' agrees in the instrumental masculine.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О романе' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to express what is discussed. 'Новом' agrees in the prepositional masculine.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Романы' is the nominative plural subject of 'стали'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'классикой' is the instrumental predicate after 'стали'.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Романы' is the accusative plural object of 'люблю', identical to the nominative plural for this inanimate noun. 'Исторические' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Романов' is in the genitive plural after 'много', which governs the genitive of counted items. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Роман' is the accusative object of 'закончил', identical to the nominative for this inanimate noun. 'Свой первый' agree in the masculine accusative.
